breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the full formula τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg/2)^2 + τ_avg^2), which includes both the normal stress and shear stress contributions. The computed τ_max = 4 MPa confirms this formula was applied (using σ_avg = 6.25 MPa and τ_avg = 2.5 MPa), rather than incorrectly using only τ_avg alone as the incomplete prompt suggested. This matches the ground truth approach.
